CustomField.description: Override the default mapping Flow with a custom Flow. When adding new picklist options ensure the picklist value is set to the API name of the Flow that should be called, the picklist label can be a User friendly value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose which Flow maps submission fields onto the Order. Keep Default unless you've built a custom mapping Flow; add it as a picklist value whose API name matches the Flow.
CustomField.label: Conversion Map Flow (Order)
